dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit irregular, jagged outer perimeters with a soft gradient transition from a dark charcoal exterior to a light-grey interior boundary line; features a distinct fused double-annulus in the mid-dorsal region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of solid light-intensity pixel clusters lacking internal gradients, primarily distributed along the lower lateral margins and transitioning into smaller, more frequent spots toward the posterior.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the most prominent central '8'-shaped annulus and two adjacent circular annuli to its right form an obtuse scalene triangle; a secondary group of four annuli creates an irregular quadrilateral in the upper dorsal-posterior field.

other_distinctive_markers: A unique fused double-annulus structure resembling a horizontal figure-eight is visible in the central-left dorsal region.
